The following events took place in '''27,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*A [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ship]] reaches the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]], leading to the creation of [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] society.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*Within a millennium, [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]], [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] and [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]] will receive human colonists.<ref name="TEA" />
*[[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] and [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] scientists develop an [[Tumbledrive/Legends|experimental hyperdrive]].<ref name="TEA" />
*The [[Gossam Courivers/Legends|Gossam Courivers]] first explore [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="TEA" />
*The [[Gree-Kwa conflict]] comes to an end after millennia of war.<ref name="TEA" />
